name: historical_false_contradiction_controls
purpose: Existing committed regression examples; only non-contradiction is adjudicated. No private production documents accessed.

items.claim: Donepezil, at clinically achievable human brain free concentrations of 10-30 nM, occupies sigma-1R (Ki ~14 nM) at the ER-mitochondria contact site.
passages: The same ligand is ineffective at blocking wild-type NaVs and does not disrupt action potential signals in neuronal cells or brain tissue at working concentrations.

items.claim: GBM cells engage compensatory stress-response programs (autophagy-glycolysis crosstalk) to survive metabolic stress.
passages: These findings identify a novel and complex compensatory interplay between glycolysis, autophagy, and senescence that helps maintain stemness in heterogeneous GBM tumor subpopulations.

items.claim: Together, these actions reduce collagen synthesis and α-SMA expression, attenuating the fibrotic phenotype.
passages: Wnt inhibition and the fibrotic phenotype in cardiac fibroblasts. Treatment with LGK-974 significantly reduced both α-SMA and collagen type I expression, whereas ETC-159 selectively decreased collagen type I. Body weight did not differ between groups.

items.claim: Metformin activates AMPK in human cardiac fibroblasts, leading to inhibitory phosphorylation of Smad3 (Ser203/207) and suppression of HIF-1α-mediated glycolysis, thereby blocking TGF-β-induced myofibroblast transition and collagen deposition.
passages: Pirfenidone attenuates lung fibrotic fibroblast responses to transforming growth factor-β1. Furthermore, pirfenidone attenuated TGF-β1- and CTHRC1-induced fibroblast activity, upregulation of bone morphogenic protein-4(BMP-4)/Gremlin1, and downregulation of α-smooth muscle actin, fibronectin, and FHL2, similar to that observed post-CTHRC1 inhibition. Myofibroblast transition and collagen deposition were assessed in human cardiac fibroblasts after TGF-β1 stimulation. AMPK phosphorylation, Smad3 phosphorylation and glycolysis were measured; HIF-1α protein was quantified. Body weight did not differ between groups.

items.claim: Metformin enters cardiac fibroblasts and activates AMPK via LKB1.
passages: AMPK activation in fibroblasts under nutrient stress. We found that glucose starvation transiently activates AMPK, whereas changes in glucagon and insulin levels had no impact on AMPK. Body weight did not differ between groups.
